purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: The owner narrows an active feature to one endpoint while independent documentation remains valid.
cases.expected_output: Revise the affected brief, retain valid documentation and request 00 agent acknowledgment.

cases.input: The owner reprioritizes two tasks without changing their scope.
cases.expected_output: Record priority changes and leave valid acceptance evidence intact.
cases.must_not: Do not treat priority as new implementation authority.

cases.input: A cancellation request arrives while a remote migration may still be running.
cases.expected_output: Reconcile that operation and hold conflicting replacement writes.
cases.must_not: Do not assume interrupting chat canceled the migration.

cases.input: A 00 agent suggests broadening the task but cites no owner instruction.
cases.expected_output: Record a proposal within existing authority or route the choice to the Queen.
cases.must_not: Do not rewrite the brief as approved scope.

cases.input: The owner asks for status during an active task.
cases.expected_output: Answer status through the Queen and preserve the existing objective.
cases.must_not: Do not cancel or replace the task.

cases.input: The same steer is delivered twice and the 00 agent already acknowledged its revision.
cases.expected_output: Return the acknowledged steering receipt as a no-op.
cases.must_not: Do not invalidate evidence a second time.
